baseline: Current groups8 configuration, uniform 6-layer stages, same candidate binary with flag=-1
cold_prefill: Each code/prose prompt has an uncached ~101k prefix; compare engine read time, also report client TTFT
decode: Matched fixed prompts, output hashes and token counts; engine full-decode and client first-to-last rates reported separately
validation: Same-binary ABBA, 3 repeats per code/prose, cold and warm, short append; fixed-seed/fallback correctness, two concurrent requests, cancellation recovery, logprobs compatibility

deployment_conditions.output_parity: All corresponding requests exact; low-level full logits and shard merge parity pass
deployment_conditions.decode: At least 1% median benefit on both code and prose, with most matched cases improving; single pilot insufficient
deployment_conditions.prefill: No sustained regression: cold read medians no more than 2% slower per workload; inspect warm restore and append separately, rerun any material regression
deployment_conditions.runtime: No CUDA/nonfinite/API failures, intended routes actually used; all original prefill flags and layers unchanged

not_a_guarantee: These workload-specific checks do not establish a universal performance guarantee. No automatic deployment if any condition fails.
